saturn.description: The operating system for your freelance business. Saturn brings projects, timesheets, invoices, proposals, expenses and client management into one place. No more spreadsheets or chasing emails. Whether you're a solo developer or an agency of 20, Saturn adapts to how you work, with multi-currency support and team workspaces.

voto.description: A realtime voting platform where organisations can register and create junior admins to create and manage polls, register candidates and allow them to participate in certain polls, voters can register and vote for their favourite candidates and view a realtime graph of the results. Used by 3000 voters and over 7000 votes casted in the first 1 month of launch.
